title: Hello Fellow Dream Mall Visitors and Beyond
content: Hello all, recently learned about this forum and thought I should join in. &#x200B; I've been having "recurring" dreams that all feel connected in some way for at least a couple years now, if not more. I don't like using the word recurring, because while the dreams feel connected to others and familiar to other dreams I've had, they rarely ever feel like I am having the exact same dream. It's more of a familiarity feeling that I feel I have returned to the same universe in the dream, not so much the same location. &#x200B; Saying that, I have a lot of dreams that take place in Malls, and schools I've been to as a child and teenager. I have other recurring dreams but schools and malls are the main frequent dreams I have. &#x200B; The malls and schools have some similarities to real ones I've visited but typically have their own feeling to them and essentially they're never 100% true to life and have their own identifiable differences to them than in their real life counterpart. &#x200B; Same applies to the school dreams, these are based on real schools, some dreams the schools have a mix of features from several schools in them or they're partially different than reality with some similarities. &#x200B; There's a feeling of nostalgia in the mall dreams, like I've been there before, and a feeling of wonder like I've never been there before. Think of that feeling as a kid, going to a movie theater to see a movie you're hyped about, or to visit an arcade. Overall happy giddy nostalgic feeling. The school dreams are nostalgic too, but I never feel I belong there. I'm always aware I'm an adult and shouldn't be in there, but yet at the same time I do feel I belong there at that time. They're weird feelings. &#x200B; The malls are usually half empty, including the stores I visit in the dreams. I've been in food courts in these dream malls that feel both familiar and alien at the same time. The mall is also typically very large, several floors and shops in them, although the shops are usually nondescript unless I'm actually in them "shopping". Idk if I can say the malls feel futuristic, there is a feeling in my dreams that indicate the future, and the past at the same time. Hard to say for sure. &#x200B; The school dreams typically have long hallways, an auditorium, and I'm always aware that I should be graduated yet I am aware I'm back for "just one class". I rarely speak with anyone in these dreams, but I'm typically a cool senior who doesn't feel shy in the dreams. &#x200B; I would say both locations are a part of my dreams quite frequently. Maybe not daily but almost weekly or more. To clarify, there's several locations in my dreams that feel familiar, and this familiarity is a mixture of similarities to real locations as well as not real aspects to them so it feels almost surreal in a sense. There's other recurring themes in my dreams, like I'm in a both familiar yet unknown seedy part of Town, usually accompanied by some kind of partner (no, not romantically) who is helping me on whatever it is I'm doing. While these dreams are differing, they too have a familiar universe feeling to them that feels oddly comforting in the dreams. Sometimes they're in a run down bar, on a street with outdoor shops, etc. These feel different to the dreams of schools and malls but feel connected to those like they're in the same world. &#x200B; This might sound a bit outlandish and I understand dreams may have a deeper, more subconscious meaning to them. I don't know if im visiting other people's dream worlds when I dream however I sure feel I'm visiting a familiar world of my own in my dreams. I look forward to reading more posts on this forum about the mall world dreams and beyond. Thank you for your time, glad I'm not the only one who returns to these worlds lol
